name: Incense of Mastery (10x, Non-Trade)
description:
Increases all Expertise Points earned
by you by 900% for 30 minutes.

*Effect is overridden when the same item
 or another Incense of Mastery is used.
*Automatically applied to yourself
 when used.

name: Balm of Life (Non-Trade)
description:
Allows you to resurrect on the spot
when you die without losing any XP.

*Cannot be traded.
*If you also have a normal Balm of
 Life, this item will be used up first.

name: Incense of XP (10x, Non-Trade)
description:
使用してから３０分間、自分自身の
経験値獲得量＋９００％増加。

※同じアイテム、もしくは他の経験の香の
　重複使用は上書きされる。

name: Hourglass of Reversal (Non-Trade)
description:
Reconverts all abilities such as
Strength and Magic into Attribute Points
that you can then redistribute 
as you like.
*Cannot be traded.

name: 月影鏡・望（譲渡不可）
description:
使用すると鏡に集約された月の力により、
月齢に関係なく、魔装術・魂合術の
成功率が１５％上昇する。

※魔晶変化には使用できない。
※魔装術、魂合術に使用すると消失する。
※魂合術に失敗しても、
　魔晶及び魂合石が失われることはない。

name: Incense of Mastery (5x, Non-Trade)
description:
Increases all Expertise Points gained
by an ally by 5 times for 30 minutes.

*Effect is overridden when the same item
or another Incense of Mastery is used.
*Cannot be traded.

name: Incense of XP (5x Demon, Non-Trade)
description:
使用してから３０分間、仲魔の
経験値獲得量＋４００％増加。

※同じアイテム、もしくは他の経験の香の
　重複使用は上書きされる。
※チャットオプションの設定により、
　仲魔の経験値の表示・非表示が可能。

name: Diamond
description:
The birthstone for April, the diamond is
the hardest of all metals and retains
its form for decades and centuries
without losing its sparkle.

name: Pearl
description:
The birthstone for June, the pearl is
a biogenic mineral produced by
pearl shells. Even Japan, with its lack
of mineral deposits, was able to offer
the world its share of beautiful jewelry
thanks to its use of pearl farming.

name: Sapphire
description:
The birthstone for September,
the sapphire was considered a symbol
of the clergy in medieval Europe, with
even the Pope sporting a sapphire ring.
It is a blue gem symbolizing loyalty
and purity.

name: Emerald
description:
The birthstone for May, the emerald has
a long history going back to ancient
Babylonia, where it was traded. Queen
Cleopatra was a fan of its green
glimmer.

name: Ruby
description:
The birthstone for July, the name ruby
comes from ruber, the Latin word
for red. Its passionate color offers
the courage to pursue one's goal
and is said to make one's romantic
wishes come true.

name: Jade
description:
The birthstone for May, jade is a green
jewel with more of a history in Japan
and China than in the West.
It symbolizes authority and status.

name: Opal
description:
The birthstone for October, the opal is
a beautiful gem that glitters in many
different colors. 
It was known as the gem of the gods
in ancient Rome, where it was held in
very high esteem.

name: Amethyst
description:
The birthstone for February,
the amethyst is named after Amethystos,
a servant to Diana,
the Greek goddess of the moon,
whose story ended in tragedy.

name: Peridot
description:
The birthstone for August, the peridot
has an olive glimmer that has been
believed since ancien times to have
the power to heal and ward off evil.

name: Turquoise
description:
The birthstone for December, turquoise
has long been considered a sacred stone
in many parts of the world. The ancient
Egyptians offered it as gifts
to the gods Osiris and Isis.

name: Garnet
description:
The birthstone for January, the garnet's
amber glow was said to have acted as
a guiding light for Noah as he sailed
the dark, flooded world in his ark.

name: Topaz
description:
The birthstone for November, the topaz
normally comes in yellow, but can also
be found in blue, green and pink.
It symbolizes friendship and hope.

name: Coral
description:
A birthstone for March,
coral is a biogenic mineral produced
in the sea. Coral is said to bring
luck and beauty to young women
in Scotland, and is used in the jewelry
handed down among the British royalty.

name: Aquamarine
description:
A birthstone for March, aquamarine has
a translucent blue color like the sea.
European sailors once considered this
gem to contain the powers of the sea
and kept them as lucky charms.

name: Philosopher's Stone
description:
A lovely gem that countless alchemists
once attempted to find. Perhaps it was
formed by the indefatigable dreams of
these men, who never gave up in their
fruitless pursuit.
It can be used with a demon of any race
when performing Crystallize Demon,
and will increase the success rate.

 Character dies.

description:
怪しい光を発する不思議な箱。
遮光の調整によっては、
悪魔独自の成長に大きな影響を与える。

ソウルポイント獲得量が

　悪魔的精導光の重複使用は上書きされる。

name: 七色のピラー
description:
七つの色が混じりあう謎の柱。
この柱を使い特別な儀式を行うことで、魔界への扉が開く。

一度でも扉を開くと消滅してしまう。

name: 七曜のピラー
description:
通常、魔界への扉を開くには七つのピラーが必要だが、
七曜のピラーはそれら全てを賄うスグレモノ。
特別な儀式や４つの人形も必要なく、
魔界への扉を開くことができる。

但し、１度でも扉を開くと消滅してしまう。

name: 天上の花輪
description: 不気味な円盤が変化し、花が咲いた姿。

name: 菩提樹の実
description:
菩提樹の下に落ちていたとされる実。

使用すると、
状態変化『菩提樹の加護』が付与され、
『コクマの塔』にて紫色の宝箱から入手できる
『天上の花輪』の量が２倍になる。

※『コクマの塔』で紫色の宝箱から『天上の花輪』を
　入手すると効果は解除される。
※黒い箱から入手できる『天上の花輪』には、
　この効果は影響しない。

name: Egg of Pangu
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this strange egg contains
the very essence of the earth.

name: Ten Commandments Tablets
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
the tablets have been inscribed with
the ten covenants formed between
the One True God and the Savior.

name: Oracle Mirror
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this mirror was handed down to men by
one who was once revered as a god, so
that he may convey his wishes directly
to them.

name: Crown of the Abyss
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this crown symbolizes the highest rank
attainable in the world that lurks
in the darkest depths of the earth.

name: Bird's Spittle
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this mystical ingredient is said to
have once been used by the Dvergar in
crafting the magical collar Gleipnir.

name: Cat's Footfall
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this mystical ingredient is said to
have once been used by the Dvergar in
crafting the magical collar Gleipnir.

name: Platinum Spirit Money
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this platinum coin was once buried
along with the bodies of the dead.
If silver spirit money is used to pay
the demons that dwell in hell,
and gold spirit money is used to pay
the deities that live in the heavens,
to whom would platinum spirit money
be offered?

name: Damascus Chakram
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this disc-like throwing weapon was
said to have been crafted out of
a sacred metal by ancient gods.
Indians attempted to replicate this
metal in the medieval period, but what
they created was refined in Damascus,
which is where Damascus steel gets its
name. It is a difficult weapon for
humans to wield.

name: Amenonuboko
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this spear was left behind by the
Kotoamatsukami, gods even more ancient
than the Heavenly Gods and Nation
Rulers, and is a difficult weapon to
wield.

name: Astral Crystal
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this crystal formed from materialized
astral matter contains a high
concentration of spirits of great
purity that control alignment.

name: Necronomicon
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this evil tome contains spells
for controlling the dead.
The twisted poet who authored this
book is said to have been devoured
alive by an invisible monster.

name: Cintamani
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this sacred jewel is said to have been
located below the jaw of a dragon.
Coral stars float within the jewel's
orb, and those who possess it are said
to be granted any wish they desire.

name: Rheingold
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this sacred material has the power
to fulfill the desires of its owner.
Although valueless as a metal due to
the numerous impurities it contains,
magical rings and helmets are said to
have been crafted from this gold.

name: Leather of Amalthea
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this leather was taken off of the
hide of Amalthea, the Goat Goddess.
Aegis, the shield that Zeus offered to
Athena as a gift, is said to have been
made from this very leather.

name: Ark of the Law
description:
A miracle produced by the hands
of humans, this object cannot
easily be recreated.
It is made from a similar material
to the Ark that once contained
the Ten Commandments Tablets.

name: Mithril Wheel
description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying
an act performed by a power
far greater than man,
this cog was made from a legendary,
highly durable and processable metal.
Its maker and purpose, however,
remain unknown.

very little that can be used.

hand-selected by DB Asada.

*Can be deconstructed with an Extractor
 to obtain items.

name: Strip of Shadow
description:
An object into which the four oni of
Fujiwara-no-Chikata have been trapped.

name: OOPTH of Hatred
description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this evil tome contains spells for controlling the dead. The twisted poet who authored this book is said to have been devoured alive by an invisible monster. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. *The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this mystical ingredient is said to have once been used by the Dvergar in crafting the magical collar Gleipnir. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. *The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

description:
One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this leather was taken off of the hide of Amalthea, the Goat Goddess. The Aegis shield that Zeus offered to Athena as a gift, is said to have been made from this leather.
 Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. *The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, the tablets have been inscribed with the ten covenants formed between the One True God and the Savior. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. *The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this sacred jewel is said to have been located below the jaw of a dragon. Coral stars float within the jewel's orb,  and those who possess it are said to be granted any wish they desire. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. *The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

name: OOPTH of Desire
description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man, this sacred material has the power to fulfill the desires of its owner. Although valueless as a metal due to the numerous impurities it contains, magical rings and helmets are said to have been crafted from this gold. Similarly to Remains of Tokyo, the element can be extracted. *The raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyzer: Extractors.

name: OOPTH of Slight Blindness
description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Platinum coin burred with the dead. It's said that Gold Spirit Money is paid to deities and Buddhas Silver Spirit Money is paid to demons of hell. Then for whom was the Platinum Spirit Money made for...  Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

name: OOPTH of Little Grief
description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Sign of the one who is of the high rank in the world of Abyss. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

name: OOPTH of Little Wonder
description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man It's not easy to create the same exact thing. It's supposedly made of the same material as what the 10 Commandment tablet was stored in. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

name: OOPTH of Small Sign
description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man The one whom was worshiped as a god gave this mirror to humanity so they can share thoughts. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

name: OOPTH of Little Thirst
description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man this mystical ingredient is said to have once been used by the Dvergar The rumor is that it was used to craft the magical collar Gleipnir. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

name: OOPTH of Small Celebration
description: One of the Sacred Relics signifying an act performed by a power far greater than man Mystical egg said to be filled with materials of the earth. Similarly to 'Remains of Tokyo' the element can be extracted. 窶ｻThe raw material can be acquired using Deconstruction Catalyze: Extractors.

name: Yoiyami Kitan
description:
An object that seems to inspire feelings 
of wonder and majesty. For whatever 
reason  though  it reeks of alcohol...

*Cannot be traded.

name: HEPA
description: Amplification liquid developed in research process of cultivation. Although it has already been decomposed it can be used culture.

name: Culture Booster (1 day)
description: When it is used as manure item in culture culture machine can accumulate the permissible concentration up to the amount culture machine can accumulate for 1 day. *Cannot be traded or sold.

name: Culture Booster (Entire period)
description: When it is used as manure item in culture culture machine can accumulate the permissible concentration up to its limit. *Cannot be traded or sold.

name: Roaring Hammer of Life's Lament
description:
An odd amalgamation that is sensitive to 
even the most delicate of ripples in the 
time stream.

*Cannot be traded.

name: Bitter Alcohol of Deceit
description:
An unpalatable alcohol that was used to 
dye the earth red and seal away a 
certain object.

*Cannot be traded.

name: Red String of Fate
description:
The length of this crimson thread 
determines the duration of your life.

*Cannot be traded.

name: Chronometer of Destiny
description:
A timepiece that solemnly 
carves the predetermined timespan.

*Cannot be traded.

name: Nacre Crimson Shoes
description:
Red heels with the faint smell 
of the one who liked to wear them.

*Cannot be traded.

name: Cloak of Yakumo
description:
A cloak worn by a hero who left
his mark on the land of eight clouds.

name: Divine Bracer
description:
An accessory that lets off a 
thunderous sound when firing a bow.

name: Sunlight Hair Ornament
description:
全てを照らしだす燦々とした陽光が
封じられた物体。

description:

「睡眠」の状態変化を解除する。

※魔階深層部でのみ使用できる。

name: 兵信魔符・？？遁？（魔具）
description:
必勝の法が封じられた呪符。
使用することで解放できる力は大きく限られる。

（！）のつくダンジョンを
仲魔のみで進入した際に使用できる。

使用する事で、召喚中の仲魔に対して
以下の状態変化を付与する。

・近接、射撃、魔法、補助＋１

この効果は、
最大で３０回まで重ねて適用される。
効果は、２０秒間持続する。

※使用期限内は何度でも使用可能。
